visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-angle close-up of a thick steak being seared on a professional griddle, with juices bubbling and steam rising from the browned surface. The scene then cuts to a male presenter with medium-length brown hair, wearing a black pinstriped blazer over a black t-shirt. He stands in a studio environment with a blurred background featuring industrial-style graphics and text like 'Breaking news'. (2) A graphic overlay appears showing the silhouette of a cow divided into various red-colored meat cuts against a dark, textured background. One specific cut at the rear leg is highlighted as the presenter speaks and gestures with his hands. (3) The visual shifts to a cinematic slow-motion shot of snow-covered tree branches against a white sky, which then dissolves into a macro shot of a highly marbled piece of raw beef sitting on a leaf, emphasizing the white fat patterns. (4) The presenter reappears in the studio, using hand gestures to explain a concept. This is followed by more close-up shots of succulent, cooked steak being sliced on a griddle, revealing a pink, juicy center. (5) A static shot displays the 'MINIYAKI' portable griddle on a wooden table, surrounded by a feast including a burger, french fries, soda cans, and condiments. The griddle is compact and silver. (6) A series of fast-paced cuts demonstrate the product's features: a 3D animation of the griddle parts assembling, a person's hand folding the metal legs, and the griddle being used outdoors to cook fish in parchment paper. (7) The final sequence shows the griddle being cleaned under a kitchen faucet with a sponge and soapy water, followed by the presenter in the studio giving a final call to action with a pointed finger gesture.

A male narrator begins speaking in a friendly, energetic, and highly articulate tone, explaining the origins of 'shuangjiang' steak. (3) Subtle 'whoosh' transition effects and a bright 'ding' sound indicate visual shifts between the studio and close-up graphics. The music remains consistent in the background. (4) As the product features are described, the sound of metallic clicking and sliding is heard, mimicking the folding mechanism of the griddle. (5) The sound of splashing water and scrubbing is clearly audible during the cleaning demonstration, providing realistic auditory feedback. (6) The video concludes with the narrator increasing his vocal arousal for a final call to action, with the music swelling slightly before a quick fade-out.
